source: Owner direct chat after playing the retained lobby
owner_message_original: Я побегал по лобби и мне в целом все нравится, только вот дульное пламя от выстрела прям какое то тусклое, чуть бы поярче его сделать.
owner_message_english_translation: I ran around the lobby and generally like everything, but the muzzle flame when firing looks rather dim; make it a little brighter.
decision: Make a modest brightness-only adjustment to the current rifle muzzle flame and verify actual shooting in the retained lobby.
interpretation: The owner reports general satisfaction with the played gameplay baseline. This does not identify or accept paused environment or original-character candidates, nor pre-approve the new flash tuning.
preservation: Preserve existing gameplay, lobby lighting and geometry, source assets, prior evidence and unrelated owner edits. Apply the standing focused-verification and task-closure-commit requirements.
